claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament has a total purse of $22.5 million.
Rory McIlroy is the winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
The winner of the 2026 Masters Tournament earns a $4.5 million prize.
The 2025 Masters Tournament purse was $21 million.
The runner-up in the 2026 Masters Tournament earns $2.43 million.
All professionals missing the cut in the 2026 Masters Tournament receive $25,000.
The winner's share in the 2026 Masters Tournament is 20% of the total purse.
3rd place in the 2026 Masters Tournament earns $1.53 million.
4th place in the 2026 Masters Tournament earns $1.08 million.
The 2021 Masters Tournament purse was $11.5 million.
